item.title: Top Five Movie Sequels Nobody Asked For But Were Amazing
item.description: Sequels get a bad rap. Often they’re lazy cash-ins, rehashing ideas nobody wanted and reminding us why the original was special. But sometimes, a sequel sneaks up out of nowhere, exceeds all expectations, and becomes something truly memorable — even if no one was asking for it in the first place.
